text:
carmen v: Vendor PM asked for a single "handshake" plan that sequences marketplace SKU flips, SI onramp, and the joint announcement for H100/H200/MI300. They want one canonical timeline + a 1-page ops runbook.
noah reed: Agreed. Our constraints: APAC firmware certs often take extra biz days, and legal-EU needs 72h on docs. Propose T-10 to T+10 staging window with staggered region rollouts.
zara iqbal: Ops can carve a staging VLAN and temporary ACLs. Suggest per-region canary counts: NA 70 slots, EU 45, APAC 25 (MI300-heavy).
carmen v: Draft sequencing suggestion:
```
T-12: share compatibility matrix + signed-manifest process with partners
T-8: open SI invites + reserve staging VLANs
T-5 -> T-1: SI dryruns (phased by region)
T-2: internal marketplace tag publish (NOT public)
T0: press window (48-72h notice to press)
T+1..+3: canary customers + monitoring window
T+7: APAC final lift after firmware sign-off
```
noah reed: Routing fallback: if thermal/ooms spike >10% in 15m, auto-route models to compatible B200/mi300 variants. I'll PR a routing policy snippet with variant names.
zara iqbal: SKU naming draft: `h100-v5-market`, `h100-v5-signed`, `h200-v2-market`, `mi300-v3-onprem`. I'll add these to the partner SKU sheet.
mila su: Legal/PR ask: include a short embargo checklist (who receives embargo, embargo expiry, legal signoff). I'll draft and tag `legal-eu`.
devops-bot: Calendar event created: "HW vendor handshake: SI dryruns + marketplace tag window" on 2026-11-02 09:00 UTC. Invitees: partnerships, eng-runtime, ops, legal-eu
carmen v: Action items: @zara reserve VLAN + post CIDRs, @noah draft routing PR, @mila draft embargo checklist, @zara push SKU mapping. Please check off by EOD Monday.
noah reed: +1
zara iqbal: +1
mila su: +1
devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping channel 7 days before T-12.
